svg.title: DAG for the example query: time_table feeds t1, t1 feeds t2 (last_by) and t3 (natural_join), and t2 feeds the latest Timestamp per Label into t3. When t1 gets a new row, t2 updates that Label's row and t3 adds the row and modifies every row whose Label matches the changed t2 row.
